adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the authorization flag is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))` and stored in `isTeamAdminOrOwner`. This requires the user to be BOTH a team admin AND a team owner to pass the team-role branch, which contradicts the variable name and typical intended policy (admin OR owner). As written, a team admin who is not also an owner would be incorrectly denied unless they also satisfy `isOrganizer` or `isAttendee`.
